name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio: Jean-Pierre's motorsport journey began in the Swiss Alps, tinkering with his father's rally car. He honed his skills at ETH Zurich, focusing on computational fluid dynamics and vehicle dynamics. A decade spent with Sauber honed his race engineering expertise, followed by a shorter stint at a smaller team where he developed innovative suspension setups. He prides himself on his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the drivers, creating a seamless feedback loop for performance improvement. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his unflinching dedication to extracting every last tenth of a second from the car.

physical.description: A man of average height with a focused gaze, Jean-Pierre exudes an aura of quiet competence.

quirks: Always carries a Swiss Army knife, even at the track.
Methodically cleans his workspace at the end of each day, regardless of the hour.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
